subject: Little Blue Button immediate pre-trigger availability
summary: Two independent current-version guides verify the Cataclysm cutoff, and a continuous Game8 Japan walkthrough directly maps its trigger to the end of cp022 before cp023. No source observes the Emberdale child immediately before that trigger and then absent afterward.
acceptance_condition: A current-version continuous walkthrough or save-tested observation confirming the child's presence immediately before cp022's Cataclysm trigger; post-trigger absence is already directly published.

subject: Lucky Panel probability algorithm
summary: hyperWiki publishes numeric selection cells, but no denominator, draw algorithm, or proof that the values convert directly to percentages.
acceptance_condition: Independent current-version mechanics documentation or controlled sampling/source-code evidence establishing the draw algorithm and denominator.

subject: Stella / Stellar Fan English UI name
summary: Multiple current guides use Stellar Fan while RPG Site says Stella Fan follows the game menu; no legible English in-game capture adjudicates the conflict.
acceptance_condition: A legible current-version English inventory, Item List, shop, or acquisition-result capture showing the complete name.

subject: Reproducible farming rates
summary: Published farming pages establish routes and tactics, but available time claims omit enough party, difficulty, patch, encounter, and measurement detail to prevent comparison.
acceptance_condition: A reproducible benchmark naming patch, platform, difficulty settings, party/build, route, sample duration, attempts, and measured rewards.

subject: Six finite pickup container members
summary: Independent current-version walkthroughs confirm each room, container group, and reward set for Dragon Shield, Knuckledusters, Pirate's Hat, Silk Robe, Steel Helmet, and Faraday Strength Ring, but do not identify the individual chest, wardrobe, or drawer.
acceptance_condition: A current-version map, legible capture, or continuous walkthrough that opens and identifies the individual container for one or more of the six grouped routes.

subject: Repeatable Monster Heart routes
summary: Current guides publish finite Heart rewards and acquisition lists, but no checked source explicitly proves that a Heart-bearing fight, arena reward, or encounter can be repeated for additional Hearts.
acceptance_condition: Explicit current-version rematch, respawn, repeat-reward, or repeatable-drop evidence for a named Heart route.

subject: Same-item accessory and Heart duplicate stacking
summary: Two independent current-version player accounts establish that one character may equip two Rabbit Tails and that multiple Rabbit Tail drop effects stack qualitatively. This resolves Rabbit Tail only: the numeric formula and cap, identical non-Rabbit-Tail accessories, and same-name Monster Heart legality and effect stacking remain unknown.
acceptance_condition: Direct current-version UI/mechanics evidence separately establishing same-item legality and effect stacking for non-Rabbit-Tail accessories and Monster Hearts, plus controlled Rabbit Tail counter/drop tests for the per-copy formula and cap.

subject: Remaining cumulative achievement semantics
summary: Thresholds are structured; individual-monster units and in-battle wins are verified, while successful field attacks, no-combat quick wins, and party-wide Let Loose aggregation have attributed definitions. Six questions remain: Massively Minted's simultaneous-balance versus lifetime-acquisition conflict; quick-win overlap with Field Day; quick-win victims in Monster Masher and Metal Mangler; multi-enemy quick-win units; exact metal-family membership; and save-slot/New Game/demo-transfer/reset behavior.
acceptance_condition: Controlled current-version counter deltas or publisher/in-game documentation resolving the gold conflict, quick-win overlaps and units, exact metal-family roster, and save/reset scope.
